headline: NVO Stock Ends Three-Month Winning Streak As Novo Nordisk’s Key Heart Drug Flops, Competition Goes To Court
summary: The Danish drugmaker reported on Friday that its experimental cardiovascular drug ziltivekimab failed a key late-stage trial, marking a significant pipeline setback in its efforts to diversify beyond blockbuster obesity and diabetes treatments.
